name: mts-event-manager
description: Event-Label navigation, snippet helpers, image and paperdoll preview for Mind the School RenPy events.

mtsEventManager.enableCodeLens.description: Show CodeLens for events and labels.

mtsEventManager.enableDiagnostics.description: Validate Event argument structure against discovered schemas.

mtsEventManager.enableImagePreview.description: Show CodeLens and hover image previews on pattern show calls.

mtsEventManager.enablePaperdoll.description: Show paperdoll CodeLens, hover previews, and the paperdoll editor on register/display calls.

mtsEventManager.enablePortraits.description: Show character portraits inline before dialogue speaker variables.

mtsEventManager.imageHoverSecondsPerFram.description: Seconds each image is shown in the hover auto-carousel.

mtsEventManager.imageRoots.description: Additional base folders for resolving Pattern image paths (absolute or workspace-relative). Workspace **/game folders and game/mods/* (mod asset roots) are always included.
